visual_review_method: Each of the 14 full-page PNGs was opened and visually inspected after rendering. Text extraction was used only to locate pages.

Table 16.1 ToricGT benchmark: all six rows, mean +/- standard-deviation entries, labels, and uncertainty qualification fit.
Proposition 16.17 feasible-Hilbert/cost-gap bound: nonempty feasible set, unit state, commutation/unitarity, and probability bound render clearly.
Centered-Gaussian hypothesis and conditional-polarization equation (22.13), with full-sky cosmic-variance proposition, render correctly.
Continuation of the conditional-Gaussian proof and nuisance Schur complement: matrix indices/inverses and display equation fit.

Start of DiagramGrammar.lean listing: imports, scope comment, typed Diagram/Context constructors and beginning of fill are complete within frame.
Sequential semantics/context/rewrite listing: forall symbols and linear-map subscripts render, wrapped lines remain readable and no symbols are missing.

Hodge-conjugacy listing and all 16 check/axiom commands: complex-field glyph, adjoint superscripts and both endpoint conditions render; final audit commands are complete.

limits: This is bounded visual QA of the selected pages, not a claim to have visually inspected every page of the 248-page monograph.
The separate mathematical audit and Lean kernel records govern proof scope; rendering does not verify mathematics or executable code.
No manuscript source was edited during this visual QA.
